Classic Buttermilk Pancakes

Makes 8 pancakes, enough for 4 people. These are the fluffy pancakes we make every Saturday, and the batter rests for five minutes while the pan heats.

What you need

AmountIngredient
2 cupsflour
2 tablespoonssugar
2 teaspoonsbaking powder
2 cupsbuttermilk
2eggs
3 tablespoonsmelted butter

How to make them

  1. Whisk the flour, sugar and baking powder in a bowl.
  2. Beat the buttermilk, eggs and butter, then stir them into the flour.
  3. Cook ladles of batter in a hot pan until bubbles form, then flip.
